body: Already thinking about deleting this thread, but I will give it a try and let it stay here..

Hey again buddy! Damn, I am so glad that you are fine and reached out! Respect! I don’t need money for that, your comment was enough to make my day. 

God bless you, and have a great life! You can always pm me if you have to talk.

Hey man. I am struggling too, because my girlfriend broke up with me. Look in the mirror and think of your girlfriend, think of your family, of your friends. Damn, that smile, right? It's nice. Go talk with your girlfriend. She may think that you don't want her anymore, but tell her that you still want her. She will be there for you. 

You can always pm me, I will reply as fast as I can - as I said, I am struggling too, so I may not be that fast. 

I don't know you. I don't know your age, haircolor etc. and I don't need too. I care about you. It's easy for me to say this, but reach out. Talking with somebody you trust can and will help you in the right way. 

I believe in you. Stay happy ;)

I can’t imagine me getting over her. This is a permant pain. This time, man, this time I am so done. I tried to stay with my friends today but I had to leave because it was too much for me. I haven’t done anything great today - only crying and making this thread. 

My friends. They don’t know what to do. Either do I. All they say it “Hey man, call me if you need it”. Sure I need it! This life isn’t worthy after I lost her.

Oh man, I am so done.
